name: Kansen Saimin Virus ~Tadaima Seieki de Kakudaichuu~
original_name: 感染催眠ウイルス ～ただいま精液で拡大中～
source:
The protagonist is just a normal student, but an accident changes his life. He is infected with the "Hypno Virus". People with this virus become susceptible to hypnotism. Moreover, the virus is transfered through body fluids. He is going to infected the girls and do whatever he wants with the power of hypnotism.

[Translated from [url=http://www.noirsoft.co.jp/saiminvirus/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角只是一名普通的学生，一场意外却改变了他的人生。他感染了“催眠病毒”。携带这种病毒的人容易受到催眠的影响。此外，病毒通过体液传播。他要用催眠的力量感染女孩们，为所欲为。

[翻译自[url=http://www.noirsoft.co.jp/saiminvirus/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
